verdict.rationale: GitLab's REST API docs say you can 'control user access programmatically to maintain consistent permissions across your organization,' which is first-party evidence of organization-wide access management. Nothing in the pack shows the granularity the story asks for. The AI-agent tool policies and the group-level Agent Platform toggle are adjacent controls and earn no credit. Missing for 10: evidence of project-level roles, repository-level permissions, branch-level protection rules, environment-level (protected environment) permissions, and any detail on the permission model or independent corroboration.
